game_title: Range Check Bridge – Customs House Defense
game_concept: A survival strategy set in Coastal Port – Customs House, the port customs house: the shipwright must handle rogue crabs while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Range Check Bridge: Test ranges such as 10 <= weight < 20 to let only the right travelers cross.
theme: Coastal Port – Customs House: the port customs house
core_gameplay_loop: In Customs House, repeat each round: Test ranges such as 10 <= weight < 20 to let only the right travelers cross. Each round, rogue crabs strike the harbor bell, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the bridge_load value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the harbor bell from rogue crabs in Customs House: keep the bridge_load meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 46-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: bridge_load drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 46-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 10 (extended tier): Range Check Bridge
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Range Check Bridge' (Week 3 slot 8), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Customs House'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how bridge_load changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rogue crabs in Customs House.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 46 seconds while bridge_load > 0.
